verdict.rationale: Workable documents its own AI that screens and qualifies candidates against the role spec and returns a shortlist. It also offers AI-generated candidate recommendations based on the job ad. The evidence pack has no vendor documentation of how the matching works or what safeguards (bias controls, human review, explainability) apply to automated decisions. missing for 10: documentation of how the AI screening/matching model works, documented safeguards or human-oversight controls for automated decisions, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI helps screen and match candidates against the role — with the vendor documenting how it works and what safeguards apply to automated decisions

citations.quote: The Workable Agent runs the top of the funnel - sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate against the spec - and hands your team an interview-ready shortlist.
Receive AI-generated recommendations of qualified candidates based on your job ad from a pool of 400 million profiles.
Search yourself or use AI to find qualified candidates that match your specific requirements.
